f.title: Scope: RMPs subject to publication (new drugs/biosimilars applied for from 1 Apr 2013, new safety concerns, and their changes)
f.statement: The RMPs subject to publication (and so to the preparation and filing steps in sections 3 and 4) are: (a) RMPs of new drugs and biosimilars/follow-on biologics whose approval applications are submitted on or after 1 April 2013, submitted to PMDA under section 3-(1)-(i) and -(ii) of the RMP templates and instructions to authors; (b) RMPs submitted to PMDA by an MAH because new safety concerns have been identified since 1 April 2013; and (c) RMPs submitted to PMDA by the MAH with changes to the plans in (a) or (b).
f.applicability: Superseded version (replaced by PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0318-2 / PSEHB/PSD Notification No. 0318-1 of 18 Mar 2022, which abolished it). PFSB/ELD Notification No. 0304-1 / PFSB/SD Notification No. 0304-1 (4 Mar 2013) on publication of Risk Management Plans submitted to PMDA; English translation by PMDA provided for reference only (the Japanese original prevails)

rows.quote:
a) Risk Management Plans of new drugs and biosimilars/follow-on biologics for
which approval applications are submitted on or after April 1, 2013, submitted
to the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) based on the
section 3-(1) -(i) and -(ii) of the Risk Management Plan templates and
instructions to authors.
b) Risk Management Plans submitted to PMDA by a Marketing Authorization
Holder (MAH) because new safety concerns have been identified since April 1,
2013.
c) Risk Management Plans submitted to the PMDA by the MAH due to above a) or
b) with changing the plans.
rows.review_note: Review: scope definition with no modal verb: not a stand-alone obligation, but it fixes which RMPs the publication filing applies to, so kept as a scope row and level changed Mandatory -> Recommended (the operative duties in sections 3-4 are "should"); statement restated as scope rather than a duty. f.title: Scope of publication: RMP sections 1 to 5.3 with the cover, excluding seal and contact details
f.statement: The published part of a submitted RMP runs from section 1 "Outline of Risk Management Plan" to section 5.3 "The list of Risk minimization Plan", with a cover including a summary of the item and the change history, excluding the submitter's seal impression and the name and contact information of the person in charge.
f.clause: 2. The scope of Risk Management Plan that will be published
f.applicability: Superseded version (replaced by PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0318-2 / PSEHB/PSD Notification No. 0318-1 of 18 Mar 2022, which abolished it). PFSB/ELD Notification No. 0304-1 / PFSB/SD Notification No. 0304-1 (4 Mar 2013) on publication of Risk Management Plans submitted to PMDA; English translation by PMDA provided for reference only (the Japanese original prevails)

rows.quote:
Of a Risk Management Plan submitted to the PMDA, the part of the plan that will
be published is from the section 1 “Outline of Risk Management Plan” to the section
5.3 “The list of Risk minimization Plan” with a cover including a summary of an
item and a history of change (with the exception of seal impression by submitter, a
name and contact information of person in charge).

f.title: Title the publication document "Risk Management Plan for (brand name)" with a cover stating the submitter's responsibility
f.statement: MAHs and applicants should create a document titled "Risk Management Plan for ●● (brand name)" with a cover clearly stating that the submitter is responsible for the content and rights of the information; where there is more than one brand name, each brand name should be identified in the title on the cover.
f.clause: 3. Preparation for Risk Management Plan that will be published a)
f.applicability: Superseded version (replaced by PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0318-2 / PSEHB/PSD Notification No. 0318-1 of 18 Mar 2022, which abolished it). PFSB/ELD Notification No. 0304-1 / PFSB/SD Notification No. 0304-1 (4 Mar 2013) on publication of Risk Management Plans submitted to PMDA; English translation by PMDA provided for reference only (the Japanese original prevails)

rows.quote:
The MAHs and applicants for marketing authorization should create a
document with a title “Risk Management Plan for ●●（brand name）” and put
the cover on the published document clearly stating that the submitter shall be
held any responsible for the content and the right of any information described
in the document. In the case of more than one brand name , the document
should be identified each brand name such as that the title on the cover should
be “Risk Management Plan for ●●（brand name ）/ ▲▲（brand name）.”
rows.location: 3. Preparation for Risk Management Plan that will be published a)

f.title: File the publication document with PMDA within 5 business days of PMDA's notification
f.statement: After an RMP is submitted under section 3 of the RMP templates notification, PMDA notifies the submitter to file the document electronically for publication; after the notification the submitter should file the publication document with the International Safety Information Section, Office of Safety I, PMDA, by the means in b), within 5 business days.
f.clause: 4. Submission of Risk Management Plan that will be published a)
f.applicability: Superseded version (replaced by PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0318-2 / PSEHB/PSD Notification No. 0318-1 of 18 Mar 2022, which abolished it). rows.deadline: Within 5 business days after PMDA's notification
rows.quote:
After a Risk Management Plan is submitted based on the section 3 of the Risk

the submitter to file the document electronically for publication. After the
notification from the PMDA, the submitter should file the document created for
publication to the International Safety Information Section, Office of Safety Ⅰ,
PMDA under the following b) within 5 business days.

f.title: File by e-mail attachment up to 3 MB (otherwise on electronic media), giving submitter, drug name and authorisation date in the e-mail body
f.statement: The submitter should file the document by e-mail attachment; files larger than 3 MB should be filed on electronic media rather than as a separate attachment; the e-mail body should give the submitter's name, the non-proprietary/brand name of the drug and the date of marketing authorisation.
f.clause: 4. Submission of Risk Management Plan that will be published b)
f.applicability: Superseded version (replaced by PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0318-2 / PSEHB/PSD Notification No. 0318-1 of 18 Mar 2022, which abolished it). rows.quote:
The submitter should file the document through:
 e-mail by attaching it.
Note:
 File size should not be larger than 3MB. If the file size is larger
than 3MB, the submitter should file the document through
electronic media and not send the document as a separate
attachment.
 The submitter should put the name of submitter, the
non-proprietary name/brand name of the drug, and the date of
market authorization in the body of e-mail.
